PokeH_Farmhouse.title: Farmhouse
PokeH_Farmhouse.drawn: The farmhouse in the middle of the fields: poke_b's flower cottage drawn again with a porch across its front, a shingled roof on two posts wrapped in flowering vines, vines up its outside stair; the red bell-cast roof with two roof lights, cream walls, flower boxes under the upper windows, the teal door and the bay window under the porch.
